BiblicalUsage: Meres is one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who saw the king's face. Esther 1:14 names him among them, the men who sat first in the kingdom under Ahasuerus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the princes who sat first in the kingdom are the ones God used without their knowing it, to make room for Esther.
